structured_output.summary: This finding was about test strength: nothing checked that the keycap legend responds to a resize. The game code already handles it correctly, so I left src/ unchanged and only added a new browser test, tests/ui/keycap-legend-resize.test.ts. The test builds the screens harness and renders the 'hud--first-lap' stage in Chromium at 1440×900 with no touch. It checks that the "Keyboard controls" group is visible. It then resizes the page to 1000×700 and polls until the group is hidden, resizes back to 1440×900 and polls until it is visible again, then shrinks the page once more and checks the group hides. Finally it opens a fresh page at 1000×700, checks the legend is hidden, grows the page to 1440×900 and polls until the legend appears. Red/green: I temporarily applied the reviewer's mutation, replacing the watchDesktop call in src/ui/keycap-legend.ts with a one-off matchMedia(DESKTOP_QUERY).matches read. The new test failed: the legend stayed visible after the resize to 1000×700. I then restored the original file and confirmed it is byte-identical; the test passes against the current code. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (85 files, 615 tests).
